**Search Query:**  
"Complete unredacted medical records [CLAIMANT NAME] from [DATE] to [DATE] (five years pre-incident) showing pre-existing conditions, prior treatments, and clinical history."  
AND  
"(peer-reviewed OR preprint) modeling studies reconstructing early Wuhan COVID-19 transmission with corrections for case ascertainment bias, presymptomatic transmission, superspreading, serial-interval/right-censoring biases AND quantitative R0 estimates (median ≥5 OR 95% CI ≈5.7)".  

**Rationale:**  
1. **Medical Records**: Specifies timeframe, unredacted status, and focus on pre-existing conditions/treatments.  
2. **Studies**: Targets methodological rigor (modeling with named biases) and explicit R0 thresholds from the described epidemiological context.
